episodes.title: Secret of the Dragon Ball
episodes.summary: Goku's afternoon of fishing is interrupted by a bossy girl who is determined to get her hands on his most prized possession - a mysterious ball that belonged to his grandfather.

episodes.title: The Emperor's Quest
episodes.summary: Goku and Bulma aren't the only ones looking for Dragon Balls. The little warrior runs into a couple of Emperor Pilaf's henchmen during his search for a late night snack.

episodes.title: The Nimbus Cloud of Roshi
episodes.summary: Bulma gets annoyed when Goku slows things down to help a lost turtle, but his good deed could speed up their quest to collect the seven Dragon Balls.

episodes.title: Oolong the Terrible
episodes.summary: Another Dragon Ball is discovered in a small village. Before Bulma can claim the fifth magic ball, Goku must fight with Oolong the Terrible!

episodes.title: Yamcha the Desert Bandit
episodes.summary: Oolong joins the quest to locate the final two Dragon Balls, but the adventurers are interrupted by a desert dweller with ties to Goku's past.

episodes.title: Keep an Eye on the Dragon Balls
episodes.summary: The magic Dragon Balls are sought for many reasons. Oolong and Yamcha want success with women, Bulma wants a hot date, and Goku probably just wants something to eat.

episodes.title: The Ox-King on Fire Mountain
episodes.summary: Bulma's got a hunch about where to find another Dragon Ball. Unfortunately, it's guarded by the Ox-King, and he won't give it up unless he gets something in return.

episodes.title: The Kamehameha Wave
episodes.summary: Goku and Chi-Chi are sent to borrow a magic fan from Roshi. When the old master can't find it, he returns to Fire Mountain with his Kamehameha Wave!

episodes.title: Boss Rabbit's Magic Touch
episodes.summary: Bulma's getting free stuff all over town, but it's not because she's so good looking. It seems her outfit reminds the villagers of a bad guy named Boss Rabbit.

episodes.title: The Dragon Balls Are Stolen!
episodes.summary: As the adventurers close in on the seventh and final Dragon Ball, Bulma and Oolong argue over what their wish should be - but it might not even matter.

episodes.title: The Penalty is Pinball
episodes.summary: Goku, Bulma, and the others momentarily escape their prison only to find themselves trapped in a deadly game of pinball where Emperor Pilaf controls all the balls!

episodes.title: A Wish to the Eternal Dragon
episodes.summary: Pilaf demands revenge for his wasted wish, so he puts Oolong and company in a room designed to cook them alive! There's no way out - unless Goku can release the beast within!

episodes.title: The Legend of Goku
episodes.summary: The Emperor may have captured Goku's human form, but once the little man takes a look at the moon, nothing - except maybe a pair of scissors - can stop him!

episodes.title: Goku's Rival
episodes.summary: With the Dragon Balls once again spread across the face of the Earth, the gang has split to pursue new adventures. While Bulma, Yamcha, Oolong, and Puar struggle through the desert after their plane crashes, Goku flies to Master Roshi's island to learn martial arts.

episodes.title: Look Out for Launch
episodes.summary: While in town on an errand to prove their worth to Master Roshi, Goku and Krillin rescue the young woman Launch and bring her back to Roshi's island.

episodes.title: Find That Stone!
episodes.summary: Master Roshi takes Goku and Krillin to begin their martial arts training on a jungle island. Krillin cheats to beat Goku in the heated rivalry and wins, but soon has to pay a heavy price for his actions.

episodes.title: Milk Delivery
episodes.summary: As part of their training, Goku and Krillin must deliver milk to a person who lives high up on a mountain.

episodes.title: The Turtle Hermit Way
episodes.summary: Goku and Krillin's training continues as they till the ground with their bare hands, dodge a swarm of angry bees, and swim with sharks. Can Goku and Krillin survive the training to prepare for the World Martial Arts Tournament?

episodes.title: The Tournament Begins
episodes.summary: The greatest warriors from around the world are gathered to battle one another in the greatest martial arts tournament ever. Can Goku and Krillin make it past the Elimination Round?

episodes.title: Elimination Round
episodes.summary: The tournament is in full swing as Yamcha, Goku, and Krillin all compete to become one of the eight finalists.

episodes.title: Smells Like Trouble
episodes.summary: The final eight competitors draw lots for their match-ups in the World Martial Arts Tournament. Krillin draws the first match against an unusually repulsively oaf named Bacterian. It will take some innovative strategy to beat this monstrous man.

episodes.title: Yamcha vs. Jackie Chun
episodes.summary: The final matches continue with Jackie Chun defeating Yamcha and knocking him out of the tournament. But there is something mysterious about Jackie Chun.

episodes.title: Monster Beast Giran
episodes.summary: Goku is set to fight the fierce warrior Giran. He manages to ward off Giran's powerful attacks until Giran takes Goku by surprise.

episodes.title: Krillin's Frantic Attack!
episodes.summary: Jackie Chun and Krillin square off in the semi-final match. Unable to match Jackie in brute strength or speed, Krillin must use his wits.

episodes.title: Danger from Above
episodes.summary: Goku fights Nam, the poor farmer who has entered the tournament so that he can use the championship money to buy water for his drought-stricken village.

episodes.title: The Grand Finals
episodes.summary: The final bout begins between Goku and Jackie Chun. It's a huge battle between master and student with only one winner!

episodes.title: Number One Under the Moon
episodes.summary: The final match between Goku and Jackie Chun rages on for hours, the fighters matching technique for technique even as the sun begins to set.

episodes.title: The Final Blow
episodes.summary: The tournament has turned serious when Jackie Chun sent out his Kamehameha Wave that has destroyed half the arena and perhaps Goku with it.

episodes.title: The Roaming Lake
episodes.summary: Goku begins a search for his grandfather's Four-Star Dragon Ball and finds the adventure of a lifetime. The fate of an entire village rests on his shoulders as he braves the perilous desert to discover the secret of the mysterious Roaming Lake.

episodes.title: Pilaf and the Mystery Force
episodes.summary: The race for the Dragon Balls continues, as Goku must battle Emperor Pilaf and his cohorts for control of the Four-Star ball. Amid the chaos rises a new enemy, a mysterious horde of villains who will stop at nothing to realize their lethal agenda.

episodes.title: Wedding Plans?
episodes.summary: Pilaf is back to his sneaky tricks to get his hands on a Dragon Ball, but he isn't the only one looking! The Red Ribbon Army is also on the hunt, and they'll destroy everything in their path to get what they want.

episodes.title: The Flying Fortress: Vanished!
episodes.summary: The Ox-King's been had! Now, Goku is here to straighten it out. Emperor Pilaf made an imposter of Goku in order to steal the prized Dragon Ball. But it won't be that easy this time. Goku and an entire army are out to stop him!

episodes.title: The Legend of a Dragon
episodes.summary: Goku explores a jungle paradise in search of the Four-Star Dragon Ball. Little does he know, the diabolical Colonel Silver is hot on his tail! And when the Red Ribbon Army carves a path of destruction through the jungle, it's clear they didn't come to monkey around!

episodes.title: Cruel General Red
episodes.summary: Colonel Silver's troops scour land, sea, and air in search of the elusive Dragon Ball, but what they find is Goku! With the help of his Dragon Radar, Goku pinpoints the location of the ball and plucks it from under the noses of the Red Ribbon Army.

episodes.title: Cold Reception
episodes.summary: Goku is dragged into his most exciting adventure yet. The treacherous Red Ribbon Army threatens a peaceful village. Soldiers ravage the land in search of another Dragon Ball, destroying anything that gets in their way.

episodes.title: Major Metallitron
episodes.summary: In an effort to repay the kindness of Suno and her mother, Goku vows to rescue their kidnapped Village Chief from the Red Ribbon Army's heavily fortified Muscle Tower.

episodes.title: Ninja Murasaki is Coming!
episodes.summary: Goku's quest to save the Village Chief from Muscle Tower is in danger of coming to an untimely end when he encounters the fourth-floor guard, Ninja Murasaki.

episodes.title: Five Murasakis
episodes.summary: Fighting a ninja is difficult. Fighting five? Impossible! However, those are the odds Goku must face when Murasaki unveils his deadly trick of Separation!

episodes.title: Mysterious Android No.8
episodes.summary: Proving to be no match for Goku's skills on his own, Murasaki makes a desperate call for reinforcements. He summons the Red Ribbon Army's secret weapon, the monstrous Android Number 8!

episodes.title: Horrifying Buyon
episodes.summary: Goku and Android Number 8 confront General White at the top of Muscle Tower. But the wily General sends the duo tumbling through a trap door into the darkness of floor number five.

episodes.title: The Fall of Muscle Tower
episodes.summary: Having bested all of White's tower guards, only one obstacle stands between Goku and his goal, the General himself. In order to save the Village Chief, Goku must match strength and wits against General White.

episodes.title: The Secret of Dr. Flappe
episodes.summary: The gentle Android Number 8 is carrying a deadly secret inside of him, and a mysterious hermit, Dr. Flappe, may be his only chance at survival.

episodes.title: A Trip to the City
episodes.summary: Goku's Dragon Radar is broken, and Bulma is the only one who knows how to fix it. He needs her help, but how will he ever find her in the sprawling urban maze of West City?

episodes.title: Master Thief, Hasky
episodes.summary: Goku arrives at Capsule Corporation, Bulma's home in West City. He's hoping to have the Dragon Radar repaired, but the broken device will soon be the least of his worries! The Red Ribbon Army and their hired thief, Hasky, are hot on his tail!

episodes.title: Danger in the Air
episodes.summary: Goku and his friends celebrate by going to a spectacular amusement park. But the beautiful bounty hunter, Hasky, has Goku and his two Dragon Balls in her sights, and she intends to turn their day at Dream Land into a tragic nightmare!

episodes.title: Bulma's Bad Day
episodes.summary: Goku and Bulma find themselves on a uncharted desert. When Goku dives into the ocean waters to search for the magic ball, Bulma finds herself in deep trouble!

episodes.title: Kame House: Found!
episodes.summary: Goku and Bulma have located another Dragon Ball and travel to Master Roshi's island in hopes of finding some assistance.

episodes.title: Deep Blue Sea
episodes.summary: Goku, Bulma and Krillin comb the depths of the deep blue sea, where a third Dragon Ball waits to be claimed.

episodes.title: Roshi's Surprise
episodes.summary: Goku, Bulma and Krillin discover an ancient secret that promises great wealth, and even greater danger! The Red Ribbon Army is also on the prowl!

episodes.title: The Trap is Sprung
episodes.summary: The Red Ribbon Army is in hot pursuit of Goku through the corridors of the Pirate Cave, where danger lurks around every corner in the form of booby-traps!

episodes.title: Beware of the Robot
episodes.summary: Goku, Bulma and Krillin discover an underwater cave port at the heart of the Pirate Cave, where a sword-wielding robot lurks in the shadows!

episodes.title: The Pirate Treasure
episodes.summary: Krillin and Bulma must face General Blue alone! Can Goku make it to his friends in time to save them?

episodes.title: Blue, Black and Blue
episodes.summary: Goku, Bulma, and Krillin close in on the pirates' treasure, but they're not the only ones!

episodes.title: Escape from Pirate Cave
episodes.summary: The Pirate Cave begins to collapse on top of Goku! But that's not even the worst of it, because there is an even greater menace that threatens to destroy our hero!

episodes.title: Penguin Village
episodes.summary: Goku, Bulma and Krillin return to Master Roshi's island for some much needed rest. However, they aren't the only ones who have survived. An old foe returns, and he won't stop until he has the Dragon Balls!

episodes.title: Strange Visitor
episodes.summary: The bizarre characters of Penguin Village await Goku as he searches the countryside for General Blue and the three missing Dragon Balls!

episodes.title: Arale vs. Blue
episodes.summary: General Blue has a plane to catch, but not before settling an old score with our hero!

episodes.title: The Land of Korin
episodes.summary: The Red Ribbon Army tracks one of the Dragon Balls on a volcano island! However, a native is there to protect this sacred habitat and Goku is on his way as well!

episodes.title: The Nortorious Mercenary
episodes.summary: The Red Ribbon Army hires Mercenary Tao to eliminate Goku. The two meet on the island of Korin.

episodes.title: Tao Attacks!
episodes.summary: Mercenary Tao made short work of Bora, but Goku won't prove to be so easy. Goku is determined to avenge his friend's death and hang on to the Dragon Balls.

episodes.title: Korin Tower
episodes.summary: Goku attempts to climb the Korin Tower in hopes of finding the Sacred Water. Legend has it that whoever drinks it will be rewarded with amazing new powers.

episodes.title: Sacred Water
episodes.summary: Goku pushes on in an attempt to capture the bottle of Sacred Water from Korin. Meanwhile, Mercenary Tao prepares for a rematch against Goku.

episodes.title: The Return of Goku
episodes.summary: The fight of the century is about to begin when Goku and Mercenary Tao face off for a rematch.

episodes.title: The Last of Mercenary Tao
episodes.summary: What will Tao find at the top of the tower? And more importantly, what awaits Goku when the angry assassin comes back down?

episodes.title: Confront the Red Ribbon Army
episodes.summary: Goku makes his way to the Red Ribbon Army headquarters to take the Dragon Balls from them.

episodes.title: A Real Bind
episodes.summary: Goku's best friends have decided to help him. Can this small group of good guys conquer the legions of evil that await them?

episodes.title: The End of Commander Red
episodes.summary: In an attempt to acquire two Dragon Balls, Goku must face Commander Red and his soldiers. The ultimate battle between good and evil begins!

episodes.title: The Last Dragon Ball
episodes.summary: Staff Officer Black is on the attack, and his sights are set on Goku. The showdown between good and evil comes to its thrilling conclusion!

episodes.title: Who is Fortuneteller Baba?
episodes.summary: Master Roshi sends Goku and his friends on a quest to find the mysterious Fortuneteller Baba. She possesses the power to find lost things.

episodes.title: We Are the Five Warriors
episodes.summary: Krillin must face-off against a warrior with real bite!

episodes.title: Deadly Battle
episodes.summary: How do you fight someone you can't see? That's the problem Yamcha must face as he continues his fight against an invisible man!

episodes.title: Goku's Turn
episodes.summary: Fortuneteller Baba unleashes a threat that will test the heroes' skills and bring them to the brink of destruction: the third fighter!

episodes.title: The Devilmite Beam
episodes.summary: Goku has a big problem to solve: How can he defeat a 5,000-year-old mummy that has never been defeated? But this is only the third of Baba's fighters!

episodes.title: The Mysterious Fifth Man
episodes.summary: The battle for the last Dragon Ball continues! Now Goku has to face the fourth fighter and his deadly Devilmite Beam.

episodes.title: The Strong Ones
episodes.summary: The final battle in Fortuneteller Baba's tournament has begun, and it is quickly proving to be one for the ages!

episodes.title: True Colors of the Masked Man
episodes.summary: The battle between Goku and the masked fighter concludes in an unimaginable showdown that will forever change our hero. Meanwhile, Emperor Pilaf forges a plan to steal Goku's Dragon Balls once again.

episodes.title: Pilaf's Tactics
episodes.summary: The seventh Dragon Ball is in the possession of the greedy Emperor Pilaf and secured by his mechanized arsenal! Can Goku take the last ball?

episodes.title: The Eternal Dragon Rises
episodes.summary: Goku has collected all seven Dragon Balls! So it's off to the land of Korin to revive Upa's beloved father.

episodes.title: Terror and Plague
episodes.summary: Goku gets into trouble when he meets Chao, a little girl who persuades him to save her village from the two dangerous criminals Plague and Terror.

episodes.title: Goku vs. Sky Dragon
episodes.summary: Goku gets into the middle of a dispute between two martial arts schools, Chin-Star and Phantom-Fang. When Goku makes enemies with Sky Dragon, the leader of Phantom Fang, he must defend the Chin-Star School in a fight to determine the master of martial arts.

episodes.title: Goku Goes to Demon Land
episodes.summary: Goku's journey takes him to a small village terrorized by dozens of demons. The princess of the village was kidnapped by these fearsome creatures, and the king asks Goku for his help.

episodes.title: The Rampage of InoShikaCho
episodes.summary: The monster InoShikaCho is coming for Goku!

episodes.title: Which Way to Papaya Island?
episodes.summary: Three years have passed since Master Roshi sent Goku off. But before the tournament begins, he must learn a difficult lesson about deception and betrayal.

episodes.title: Rivals and Arrivals
episodes.summary: Master Roshi and the rest of the gang head to the World Martial Arts Tournament but Goku is still missing. If he doesn't reach the sign-in booth on time, he won't get to compete!

episodes.title: Preliminary Peril
episodes.summary: The World Martial Arts Tournament begins! Among the competitors is a dangerous opponent who almost destroyed Goku in their first encounter. Get ready for action!

episodes.title: Then There Were Eight
episodes.summary: Out of 182 fighters, only 8 will survive the elimination round. As the battles continue, Goku, Krillin and Yamcha fight to stay on top!

episodes.title: Yamcha vs. Tien
episodes.summary: The elimination round is over and Goku, Yamcha and Krillin are among the 8 finalists. The first round: Yamcha fights against his new rival, Tien!

episodes.title: Yamcha's Big Break
episodes.summary: The first fight in the quarterfinals is in full swing, with Yamcha challenging Tien. With these two warriors in battle, one thing is for sure: sparks will fly!

episodes.title: Full-Moon Vengeance
episodes.summary: Man-Wolf and Jackie Chun face each other in the second match of the quarterfinals. For Man-Wolf this fight is not about the martial arts title. It is about revenge!

episodes.title: The Dodon Wave
episodes.summary: In the third fight of the quarterfinals Krillin faces Chiaotzu, who controls the Dodon Wave.

episodes.title: Counting Controversy!!
episodes.summary: Krillin has his hands full as he continues his battle against Chiaotzu, who unleashes an even deadlier attack than the Dodon Wave!

episodes.title: Goku Enters the Ring
episodes.summary: In the fourth fight of the quarterfinals of the tournament Goku meets Panput, the world-famous fighter and action star.

episodes.title: Tien Shinhan vs. Jackie Chun
episodes.summary: The semifinal round begins with an extraordinary fight between the young Tien and the experienced champion Jackie Chun.

episodes.title: Stepping Down
episodes.summary: The fight between Jackie Chun and Tien takes on epic proportions as they continue their struggle, using every trick and technique in the book!

episodes.title: Goku vs. Krillin
episodes.summary: In the sixth fight of the World Martial Arts Tournament, friends become enemies as Goku and Krillin go head-to-head.

episodes.title: Tail's Tale
episodes.summary: The battle between Goku and Krillin comes to a head. What started as a friendly fight turns into an all-out war after Krillin pulls a sneaky stunt behind Goku's back.

episodes.title: Final Match: Goku vs. Tien Shinhan
episodes.summary: The final match in the 22nd World Martial Arts Tournament is about to begin! Goku faces Tien in a thrilling battle to see who will become the next Master of Martial Arts!

episodes.title: Victory's Edge
episodes.summary: Bruised and on the brink of destruction, Goku finds himself at the mercy of Tien, as the final match in the World Martial Arts Tournament continues.  Who will win the ultimate battle?

episodes.title: Tien's Insurrection
episodes.summary: A dramatic turn of events infuriates Tien and brings him to renewed focus and determination. There is only one outcome that satisfies the proud Tien, as he unveils a sinister new attack!

episodes.title: The Spirit Cannon
episodes.summary: Tien prepares to unleash the destructive power of the Spirit Cannon!

episodes.title: The Fallen
episodes.summary: The Spirit Cannon has left both fighters weary and exhausted. With the stage destroyed, Tien and Goku plummet towards the Earth, with the one who lands first losing the fight!

episodes.title: Enter King Piccolo
episodes.summary: While Goku sets out on a quest for revenge, his friends try to discover the identity of Krillin's killer. All the clues lead to Master Roshi's past and a demon named King Piccolo!

episodes.title: Tambourine Attacks!
episodes.summary: King Piccolo has begun his sinister plan to conquer the world. All he needs are the seven Dragon Balls and the death of all the members of the Martial Arts Society.

episodes.title: Mark of the Demon
episodes.summary: King Piccolo has sent Tambourine to kill all the warriors that could foil his plan. Goku meets a mountain man - but is he friend or foe?

episodes.title: Here Comes Yajirobe
episodes.summary: Goku fights for his honor after a mountain boy accuses him of stealing his fish. Meanwhile, Goku's friends desperately search for a way to stop King Piccolo's evil plan.

episodes.title: Terrible Tambourine
episodes.summary: Tambourine continues his campaign to slaughter the martial artists and sets his sight on Yamcha! Master Roshi embarks on a race for the Dragon Balls to stay ahead of the competition, King Piccolo and his dastardly horde.

episodes.title: Tien's Atonement
episodes.summary: Tambourine closes in on Goku and Yajirobe. To obtain one of the Dragon Balls, Tien must atone for the brutality of his past.

episodes.title: Goku's Revenge
episodes.summary: While Goku fights Tambourine to avenge Krillin's death, Master Roshi, Tien, and Chiaotzu continue their race against King Piccolo for the Dragon Balls.

episodes.title: Goku vs. King Piccolo
episodes.summary: Goku fights for his life as King Piccolo seeks revenge for the deaths of Cymbal and Tambourine.

episodes.title: Piccolo Closes In
episodes.summary: Goku makes a final stand against the seemingly indestructable King Piccolo. As Master Roshi and others continue their pursuit of the Dragon Balls, it becomes clear that the trail leads to the dark forces of King Piccolo.

episodes.title: Roshi's Gambit
episodes.summary: Master Roshi answers the call for a hero by placing himself between King Piccolo and the remaining Dragon Balls. However, in his attempt to save the world, he may have to pay the ultimate price.

episodes.title: King Piccolo's Wish
episodes.summary: Having summoned the Eternal Dragon and with no one to oppose him, King Piccolo prepares to make a wish that, if granted, could become the world's greatest nightmare!

episodes.title: Siege on Chow Castle
episodes.summary: King Piccolo sets out to conquer the world and he begins with the peaceful inhabitants of King Furry's realm. Meanwhile, Goku hopes to regain his strength by visiting Master Korin's Tower.

episodes.title: Conquest and Power
episodes.summary: Goku's reunion with Master Korin is tinged with hope and disappointment as the hero learns shocking news! Meanwhile, King Piccolo tries to force King Furry's obedience by displaying a cruel brutality towards his kingdom.

episodes.title: Awaken Darkness
episodes.summary: Goku embarks on a dangerous quest to find Ultra Divine Water. One sip could mean incredible power - or a painful death!

episodes.title: A Taste of Destiny
episodes.summary: Goku finally finds Darkness, the keeper of the Ultra Divine Water. After Goku proves himself worthy, Darkness allows him to drink the dangerous potion. But will it make him stronger or will he die?

episodes.title: The Ultimate Sacrifice
episodes.summary: Goku and Yajirobe return to Korin's tower, where Goku discovers his new powers and receives another Nimbus cloud. Meanwhile, Tien has mastered the Evil Containment Wave and decides to use it against King Piccolo.

episodes.title: Prelude to Vengeance
episodes.summary: King Piccolo has declared the destruction of the world, one sector at a time. First up is the Western City, home to Bulma's parents. Tien prepares to fight King Piccolo, but a new threat looms over everyone.

episodes.title: Battle Cry
episodes.summary: Tien must go through Drum before he can fight King Piccolo. The problem is that Drum moves faster than all three of Tien's eyes!

episodes.title: Goku Strikes Back
episodes.summary: Only Goku stands between King Piccolo and the destruction of Western City. It's more than just a rematch, it's the fight to save the world!

episodes.title: The Biggest Crisis
episodes.summary: Goku is not ready to give up power to King Piccolo without a fight. It's a fierce battle, but even Goku has his limits. How much can he take?

episodes.title: Final Showdown
episodes.summary: King Piccolo gains the advantage as he dissects Goku limb by limb. Will he surrender to King Piccolo or decide to fight and risk his own life?

episodes.title: Lost and Found
episodes.summary: The Secret of the Nyoi-BōGoku learns that there may be a way to revive his lost friends - a face-to-face meeting with the creator of the Dragon Balls!

episodes.title: Temple Above the Clouds
episodes.summary: Goku uses his Power Pole to climb to Kami's temple in the sky. When he gets there, he has to face Kami's assistant Mr. Popo in a test of strength.

episodes.title: Earth's Guardian Emerges
episodes.summary: The moment has come when Goku will come face to face with the amazing Kami, the Guardian of Earth! But even the wise Korin could not prepare Goku for what he will see when the mysterious guardian appears!

episodes.title: Eternal Dragon Resurrected
episodes.summary: Kami agrees to revive the Eternal Dragon if Goku trains for 3 years for the next World Martial Arts Tournament.

episodes.title: Quicker Than Lightning
episodes.summary: Goku's first task is a death-defying mission to the top of Mount Rumble to get the legendary Sacred Crown. To complete this task, he will have to be faster than lightning.

episodes.title: Secret of the Woods
episodes.summary: In search of a worthy sparring partner, Goku stumbles upon a surprising discovery hidden deep within the secluded labyrinth.

episodes.title: The Time Room
episodes.summary: Goku travels through time where he meets a young Master Roshi and Master Shen! While the two rivals fight for the affections of the same girl, Goku tries to gain a new power with the help of Master Mutaito.

episodes.title: Goku's Doll
episodes.summary: When Goku asks Mr. Popo for the ultimate sparring partner for his training, he gets the fight of his life!

episodes.title: Walking Their Own Ways
episodes.summary: Tien, Yamcha, Chiaotzu and Krillin are sidetracked by a village celebrating a mysterious festival in honor of its mountain spirit. When the mountain erupts, it's up to our heroes to contain the active volcano!

episodes.title: Hotter Than Lava
episodes.summary: Tien, Yamcha, Chiaotzu and Krillin find themselves in a very hot situation! It's time to put their new training to the test!

episodes.title: Changes
episodes.summary: Warriors all over the world are lining up to compete as the World Martial Arts Tournament prepares to get under way. Unfortunately, the entry-deadline is approaching and all of Master Roshi's students are missing.

episodes.title: Preliminary Peril
episodes.summary: Goku and the others compete in the exciting preliminary round. But the competition threatens to turn ugly when Goku gets a visit from an old adversary.

episodes.title: Battle of the Eight
episodes.summary: Goku, Yamcha, Krillin, and Tien battle one opponent after another in hopes of advancing to the semi-final round. Meanwhile, Master Roshi is confronted by an old rival.

episodes.title: Tien Shinhan vs. Mercenary Tao
episodes.summary: The Tournament begins with the fight between Tien and his former mentor turned cyborg, Mercenary Tao.

episodes.title: Anonymous Proposal
episodes.summary: In the second fight of the World Martial Arts Tournament, Goku faces his most beautiful opponent yet. The identity of the beautiful warrior is as mysterious as her fierce anger towards Goku, who must win the fight to learn her real name.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Hero
episodes.summary: The tournament continues with a double header! First up, Krillin battles Piccolo Junior. Yamcha jumps in the ring next, opposing Shen, whose meek appearance may hide a darker threat.

episodes.title: Rematch
episodes.summary: Yamcha scratches to stay in the ring as Shen reveals his true ability and identity. Later, Goku and Tien must face off in the semifinals.

episodes.title: Goku Gains Speed
episodes.summary: Goku unloads a heavy burden, one that may shift the balance in the epic showdown. All eyes turn to Tien as an embarrassing moment spurs him to make a dangerous decision.

episodes.title: The Four Faces of Tien
episodes.summary: When Goku's fight with Tien turns into a war against an army, he finds himself in great danger. Tien's new technique could mean the end for our hero!

episodes.title: Kami vs. Piccolo
episodes.summary: Goku is eager to fight Piccolo Junior, but Kami fears that his inexperience will be his downfall. Shen faces Junior in the semifinals, where his shocking plan is revealed.

episodes.title: Battle for the Future
episodes.summary: In the final round of the tournament, Goku faces off against his greatest nemesis. This time it's about more than just the title. The future of the world is at stake!

episodes.title: Super Kamehameha
episodes.summary: Goku has an ultimate weapon: The Super Kamehameha Wave. However, if he uses it to destroy Piccolo, Kami, who is trapped inside Junior's stomach, will be sacrificed.

episodes.title: Junior No More
episodes.summary: Piccolo reveals a startling secret that shocks the audience. Goku faces a major dilemma, because the fight for the championship becomes a fight for survival!

episodes.title: Goku's Trap
episodes.summary: As the exhausting battle between Goku and Piccolo continues, Junior surprises everyone when he reveals a new threat!.

episodes.title: Goku Hangs On
episodes.summary: Piccolo unveils a technique that threatens to destroy Goku and his friends. Even Kami believes that there is no way for Goku to survive in this massacre!

episodes.title: The Victor
episodes.summary: Goku struggles to survive when Piccolo gets the upper hand. Kami devises a way to save the young hero, but his plan requires the ultimate sacrifice!

episodes.title: Dress in Flames
episodes.summary: Goku and Chi-Chi return to her father's kingdom. But the Ox-King's castle goes up in flames!

episodes.title: The Fire-Eater
episodes.summary: Goku and Chi-Chi's search for the Bansho Fan leads them into the heart of a volcano. There they must face a powerful creature that consumes flames: the Fire-Eater!

episodes.title: Outrageous Octagon
episodes.summary: Goku's search for the Bansho Fan leads him to a mountain with a strange curse on it. Meanwhile, Ox-King tries to escape from the raging fires that threaten to destroy his castle!

episodes.title: Mystery of the Dark World
episodes.summary: Goku and Chi-Chi set out to find the Magic Furnace, which is considered the last hope to put out the fire. But before they can finish their search, Goku must solve the mystery of the Dark World.

episodes.title: The End, The Beginning
episodes.summary: Goku and Chi-Chi must travel to Mount Five Element in a last ditch effort to save her father.
